name: synthetic-nothing-on-file
description: Synthetic body, but the contact shape is LIVE-VERIFIED (2026-09-16, GET /v1/linkedin/enrich): a key answers only its OWN email kind and returns every other contact array present-but-EMPTY. This is the profile the caller did NOT ask profile_only for and that has nothing on file for this key — including the other-kind-only case, which reads identically on the wire. The vendor's either/or therefore draws exactly one SEARCH credit and nothing on the email or phone pools. Non-contact fields are placeholders; replace via `deno task record`.
